context.body: The speaker places himself as the one addressed and as the one who answers in the day of judgment.

observations.body: Jesus says not everyone calling him Lord enters the Kingdom, but the one doing his Father’s will does.
observations.label: Speaking and mighty works do not replace being known: action

observations.body: Claims of prophecy, exorcism, and mighty works meet the reply, “I never knew you.”
observations.label: Speaking and mighty works do not replace being known: response

observations.body: Lord Lord · Father’s will · prophesy · mighty works · never knew you
observations.label: Words in Matthew 7:21–23

payload.posture: Read Matthew 7:21–23 as judgment, discernment, and doing evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The passage does not identify spectacular works alone as proof either for or against the relationship claimed.
payload.title: Speaking and mighty works do not replace being known
